title: Feasibility and Safety of NeuroFlo in Stroke Patients Receiving Tissue Plasminogen Activator
brief_summary: To assess the safety and feasibility of using the NeuroFlo catheter to treat acute ischemic stroke patients following administration of intravenous tPA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ischemic stroke
* NIHSS between 5-22
* Persistent clinical deficits following administration of rt-PA

Exclusion Criteria:

* Planned thrombectomy
* Aortic pathology
* Severe heart disease
* Other conditions the doctor will assess
